archie_golden_path.description: Composed from: It is not the application we put up last time. Rodrigo's branch is the one to build — https://github.com/toolsaskarchie/archie-templates/tree/counter-and-submissions/askarchie-quotes — that is where the counter and the visitor submissions actually live. The counter and the quotes
archie_golden_path.for_when: A small containerised service that must keep its data (a counter, submissions) across restarts and scale-out, and reach it over the public internet on Kubernetes.
archie_golden_path.name: Stateful Container App on Kubernetes
archie_golden_path.not_for: Not for a stateless app that stores nothing — a plain container path with no database is cheaper. Not for anything that needs a managed SQL engine rather than a key/value table.

note: Archie is the source of truth for this path. This directory is a projection of it, so that the infrastructure remains yours and runnable if Archie goes away. Editing these files does not change the path.
